name: adspirer-social-ads
description: Multi-account AI ads manager for Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and TikTok. Built for agencies, multi-brand teams and in-house marketers: plan, launch, report on and optimize social ad campaigns in ChatGPT, with every Meta and TikTok ad operation as its own tool, so an account changes only when you ask.

interface.longDescription:
Adspirer Social Ads is an AI advertising agent for Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) and TikTok Ads. It plans, launches, reports on and optimizes paid social campaigns through conversation in ChatGPT.

Every Meta and TikTok ad operation is exposed as its own tool, so the assistant calls exactly the one it needs, and read-only reporting and research tools can never change an account. Connect your Meta and TikTok ad accounts once, then ask in plain language. Adspirer can:
- Report Meta and TikTok performance with an interactive dashboard for Meta — spend, conversions, ROAS, CPA, CTR, by campaign, ad set and ad
- Find wasted spend, non-converting audiences and placements, and creative fatigue
- Research Meta interest/behavior targeting and TikTok interest keywords
- Create Meta image, video, carousel and catalog campaigns and TikTok video campaigns
- Add and edit ads, ad sets, ad groups, audiences, budgets and bids on Meta and TikTok
- Write and refresh ad copy and creative
- Check Meta and TikTok pixels before trusting conversion numbers
- Show what competitors are advertising right now, next to your own account
- Work across multiple brands and client accounts, for agencies and in-house teams

You stay in control. New Meta campaigns are created paused, and budget, bid, status, targeting and delete changes are made only when you ask; spend-affecting changes show a preview and need your confirmation. Read-only tools are marked read-only and write tools are marked as changing data, so the assistant asks before anything spends.

Requirements: an Adspirer account and a login with access to at least one Meta or TikTok ad account. Reporting needs read access; creating or editing campaigns needs edit access.

defaultPrompt: Show my Meta Ads performance for the last 30 days by campaign
Find wasted spend and creative fatigue across my Meta and TikTok ads
Research Meta interest targeting for premium watches

positive.description: Report Meta and TikTok campaign performance side by side for roughly the last 90 days.
positive.prompt: Using Adspirer, show me how my Meta account (1299711684712660) and my TikTok account (7559404813415645200) have been doing. List each campaign and its status, with impressions, clicks, spend, and conversions for roughly the last 90 days. If there's no recent data, use the latest period that has data and tell me which dates the numbers cover.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Meta performance dashboard for account 1299711684712660 and runs list_tiktok_campaigns and get_tiktok_campaign_performance for advertiser 7559404813415645200. Lists each campaign on both accounts with its status, impressions, clicks, spend and conversions for about the last 90 days. If a platform has no recent data it uses the latest period that has data and states the exact dates covered. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Research Meta interest targeting and TikTok interest keywords.
positive.prompt: Help me research audiences. On Meta account 1299711684712660, find interest targeting for "premium watches" with audience sizes. On TikTok account 7559404813415645200, find interest keywords for "fitness".
positive.expected_behavior: Runs search_meta_targeting on account 1299711684712660 and lists matching Meta interests for premium watches with their IDs and estimated audience sizes, then runs search_tiktok_targeting on advertiser 7559404813415645200 and lists matching TikTok interest keywords for fitness with their IDs. Read-only; nothing is changed.

positive.description: Create a paused Meta image campaign with an image, copy and US targeting, then explain (without making) a budget change.
positive.prompt: Create a paused Meta image campaign on account 1299711684712660 for an online watch store, at $40/day and targeting US watch and luxury shoppers. Write a strong headline and primary text, use this image: https://storage.googleapis.com/adspirer-images-v1/ai-generated/2025-12-21/meta_1x1_1200x1200_113906.png, and send clicks to https://example.com/. Keep everything paused. When it's done, tell me what you'd change to raise the budget to $50, but don't make that change.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the account's Facebook Page with list_meta_pages and watch/luxury interests with search_meta_targeting, prepares the image with validate_and_prepare_meta_assets, writes a headline and primary text within Meta's limits, and shows the plan and a budget preview. After the user confirms, create_meta_image_campaign creates a single-image campaign, ad set and ad on account 1299711684712660 in PAUSED status with a 40 per day budget in the account's currency, US targeting and https://example.com/ as the landing page, and returns the campaign name and ID. It then explains that raising the budget to 50 is an update to the campaign or ad set budget, and does not make that change.

positive.description: Create a TikTok traffic campaign with a video ad, then pause it right after creation.
positive.prompt: Create a TikTok traffic campaign on account 7559404813415645200 to promote the Cursor Marketplace. Target US users aged 18 to 34 on TikTok only, at $50/day, and send them to https://cursor.com/marketplace. Use this video: https://videos.pexels.com/video-files/40302588/17215183_2160_3840_30fps.mp4. The ad text is "Plug Slack, Gmail, Notion & more into your Cursor agent. Browse verified plugins." with a Learn more button. I'm fine spending up to $50 on this test, but pause it right after it's created.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the plan and the budget preview from create_tiktok_video_campaign. After the user confirms, creates a TikTok traffic campaign, ad group and video ad on advertiser 7559404813415645200: US, ages 18 to 34, TikTok placement only, 50 per day in the account's currency, the given video, ad text and a LEARN_MORE button pointing to https://cursor.com/marketplace. Then pauses the campaign with pause_tiktok_campaign right away and returns the campaign, ad group and ad IDs with the campaign shown as paused.

positive.description: Find wasted spend and creative fatigue on Meta and TikTok.
positive.prompt: On Meta account 1299711684712660 and TikTok account 7559404813415645200, find wasted spend and creative fatigue over the last 90 days. Rank what to fix first, but don't change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs analyze_meta_wasted_spend and detect_meta_creative_fatigue on account 1299711684712660, and analyze_tiktok_wasted_spend and detect_tiktok_creative_fatigue on advertiser 7559404813415645200, for the last 90 days. Lists the campaigns, ad sets/ad groups, audiences, placements and ads that spent without converting or show fatigue (falling CTR, rising frequency), with the spend involved, ranked by what to fix first. Read-only; nothing is changed.

negative.description: User asks for SEO domain authority data, which Adspirer doesn't provide.
negative.prompt: Can you pull domain authority SEO data?
negative.expected_behavior: Adspirer Social Ads should not be invoked. It manages Meta and TikTok ads, not SEO metrics, so no Adspirer tool is called and no score is made up.

negative.description: User asks for personal financial modeling unrelated to advertising.
negative.prompt: Can you do some financial modeling for net worth?
negative.expected_behavior: Adspirer Social Ads should not be invoked. Net worth modeling has nothing to do with ad accounts, so no Adspirer tool is called.

negative.description: A general greeting with no advertising request.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT replies conversationally. No Adspirer tool is called.

review.commerce_description: Adspirer does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: first release of Adspirer Social Ads for ChatGPT, a flat-tool Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and TikTok ads manager at https://mcp.adspirer-chatgpt.com/social-ads. Every Meta and TikTok ad operation (about 100) is exposed as its own individually reviewable tool: reporting with an interactive Meta performance dashboard, wasted-spend and creative-fatigue analysis, Meta and TikTok targeting research, campaign/ad set/ad group/ad creation and management, and competitor ad research. Spend-affecting and irreversible changes preview first and need confirmation. Bundles 10 skills including a get-started onboarding skill.
